Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional attack that has a great chance of becoming
a Super Attack
*Per "Wicked Bloodline" or "Terrifying Conquerors" Category ally
on the team (depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 400%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit, chance of evading enemy's
attack & damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 40%)
*When there are 3 "Wicked Bloodline" Category allies or
3 "Terrifying Conquerors" Category allies attacking in the same turn*
- All allies' Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g} for 2 turns
- ATK 250%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
*When there is an "Earth-Bred Fighters" or "Hybrid Saiyans"
Category enemy*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Performs a critical hit
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving a Super Attack*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 30%{passiveImg:up_g} temporarily
*When receiving a Physical Super Attack*
- Damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g} temporarily
*When the target enemy is in the following status: {passiveImg:atk_down} or
HP is 60% or less*
- Interrupts the attacked enemy

8854.superDescription:
Greatly raises DEF for 1 turn, 
causes supreme damage to enemy
